pages.text: [#](53341a)A small-circle storm working for calling lightning where you choose.[#]()
pages.title: Rite of Sky's Wrath

pages.text: [#](53341a)The inner branch gathers the storm in the circle, the outer lashes the ground around it, and the portable branch can be cast far from home without altar power.[#]()
[#](53341a)**Snowball** and **Wood Ash** call the inner storm (1000 power). **Water Bucket** and **Wood Ash** call the outer storm (2000 power).[#]()
pages.title: The Working

pages.text: [#](53341a)**Gunpowder**, **Wood Ash**, and a **Charged Attuned Stone** restore the portable branch.[#]()
[#](53341a)A bound waystone in range moves the storm to its location — safer than standing under your own lightning.[#]()
